blocks_element.text: GREAT HAIR ANYWHERE. PICTURE THIS Dry Texture Balm brings effortless styling to a portable, makeup-inspired compact. This innovative formula delivers grit, movement, and touchable control with a soft matte finish. A blend of texture-building powders and styling agents absorbs oil, and creates shape and lasting style memory without stiffness, while conditioning oils and butters keep hair soft, frizz-free and reworkable. Designed for life on the go, it delivers flexible hold, lived-in definition and a touch-up-worthy texture wherever the day takes you.
